headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 16, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Francisco Alvarez leading the offense. Alvarez hit two home runs and drove in two runs in just three at-bats. The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0, handing them a decisive defeat. Griffin Jax led the Red Sox pitching staff, while Anthony Seigler and Caleb Durbin were among the Rays' top performers at the plate.

Several players have been affected by injuries, impacting their teams' lineups and rotations. JoJo Romero has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the St. Louis Cardinals, effective retroactive to July 14, 2026. Other players on the injured list include Brent Rooker (Athletics), Brice Matthews (Houston Astros), Brad Keller (Philadelphia Phillies), Tommy Troy (Arizona Diamondbacks), Rob Zastryzny (Milwaukee Brewers), Drew Millas (Washington Nationals), and Nick Mears (Kansas City Royals).

The Washington Nationals made a trade on July 16, 2026, sending CF Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash. The Houston Astros traded RHP Lance McCullers Jr., LHP Colton Gordon, and cash to the Milwaukee Brewers for OF Jadyn Fielder. The Detroit Tigers traded OF Jahmai Jones to the Boston Red Sox for Player To Be Named Later.
